WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT 
        cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, 
        ca_state AS ctr_state,
        ca_street_number AS ca_street_number,
        ca_street_name AS ca_street_name,
        ca_street_type AS ca_street_type,
        ca_suite_number AS ca_suite_number,
        ca_city AS ca_city,
        ca_county AS ca_county,
        ca_zip AS ca_zip,
        ca_country AS ca_country,
        ca_gmt_offset AS ca_gmt_offset,
        ca_location_type AS ca_location_type,
        SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM catalog_returns
    JOIN date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2001
        AND ca_state = 'TN'
    GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type
),
state_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ctr_state, 
        AVG(ctr_total_return) AS avg_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_state
)
SELECT 
    c.c_customer_id, 
    c.c_salutation, 
    c.c_first_name, 
    c.c_last_name, 
    ctr.ca_street_number, 
    ctr.ca_street_name, 
    ctr.ca_street_type, 
    ctr.ca_suite_number, 
    ctr.ca_city, 
    ctr.ca_county, 
    ctr.ca_state, 
    ctr.ca_zip, 
    ctr.ca_country, 
    ctr.ca_gmt_offset, 
    ctr.ca_location_type, 
    ctr.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return AS ctr
JOIN state_avg ON ctr.ctr_state = state_avg.ctr_state
JOIN customer ON ctr.ctr_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
WHERE ctr.ctr_total_return > state_avg.avg_total_return * 1.2
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_salutation, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ctr.ca_street_number, ctr.ca_street_name, ctr.ca_street_type, ctr.ca_suite_number, ctr.ca_city, ctr.ca_county, ctr.ca_state, ctr.ca_zip, ctr.ca_country, ctr.ca_gmt_offset, ctr.ca_location_type, ctr.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
